001: Ivan, what do you like to do in your free time?
I usually play the guitar or listen to music.
That's great! And how long have you been playing?
About five years now, but I'm still learning new things.
It must be really nice to play just for yourself.
Yes, for me it's the best way to relax after work.
002: Did you sign up for the new gym?
Yes, I go there three times a week after class.
And which activities do you like the most?
I really like swimming, it's relaxing.
Swimming is a great choice for your health.
I agree, and I also met some nice people there.
003: I saw you drawing in the park. Is that your hobby?
Yes, I love painting landscapes outdoors.
That's so interesting! Can I see your work?
Of course, I'll show you my sketchbook on Sunday.
I'll be looking forward to it, I'm really curious.
I hope you'll like what I create.
004: Honestly, I love baking pies and muffins.
Really? And what's your best recipe?
Apple pie, from my grandmother's recipe.
Sounds delicious, will you treat me sometime?
For sure, come over on Saturday for tea and pie.
005: Do you want to come with me to a photography exhibition?
I'd love to, I'm actually into photography myself.
Great! And do you take a lot of pictures?
Yes, mostly nature and city streets.
That probably helps you see the beauty around you.
Exactly, photography teaches me to notice details.
006: I heard you started taking dance classes. How's it going?
Yeah, I've been doing modern dance for two months now.
And how do you like it? Is it hard to learn?
It was tough at first, but now I really enjoy it.
The main thing is that you like it and have fun.
Exactly, I even feel more confident now.
007: What do you do when it rains?
I usually read books or watch old movies.
And what genre of books do you like the most?
I prefer detective stories and adventure novels.
I like detective stories too, especially the classics.
Then I can recommend a couple of great authors to you.
008: I noticed you always carry a book with you.
Yes, I try to read on the subway and during breaks.
That's a good habit. And how many books do you read a month?
Usually two or three, if I have free time.
That's impressive, I wish I read more too.
Start small — ten pages every day.
009: Do you want to go out of town with me this weekend?
I'd love to, I enjoy walking in the woods and getting fresh air.
And what else do you do outdoors?
I like picking mushrooms, and in winter I go skiing.
Sounds wonderful, we'll have an active getaway.
Yes, and I'll bring a thermos with hot tea.
010: I found out you collect stamps. Is that true?
Yes, I collect stamps with pictures of animals.
How interesting! And how many stamps do you have so far?
About three hundred, but I dream of finding rare ones.
That must take a lot of patience and attention.
But it's really fascinating and educational.
